Package org.cibseven.bpm.engine.impl

Class AdHocSubProcessActivationBuilderImpl

java.lang.Object
org.cibseven.bpm.engine.impl.AdHocSubProcessActivationBuilderImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
AdHocSubProcessActivationBuilder
public class AdHocSubProcessActivationBuilderImpl extends Object implements AdHocSubProcessActivationBuilder
Collects the performances and hands them to the command as two aligned lists.

The lists are built here rather than offered to callers, because keeping them aligned is the whole point: a caller given two lists can get their lengths wrong, and a builder cannot.

    • currentVariables

      protected Map<String,Object> currentVariables()
      The variable map of the performance named last, created on first use.

      Refusing before any activity is named is deliberate. The alternative readings -- apply to every performance, or to the next one -- are both defensible, which is exactly why a caller should not have to guess which one was chosen.

    • execute

      public List<String> execute()
      Description copied from interface: AdHocSubProcessActivationBuilder
      Starts everything named, and returns the activity instance id of each performance in the order it was named.

      An id is null when the performance has not entered an activity instance in this transaction, which is what an activity marked camunda:asyncBefore does: a job exists, an activity instance does not yet.

      Specified by:
      execute in interface AdHocSubProcessActivationBuilder
